name: Invisible Stalker — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Invisible Stalker from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Invisible Stalker" but are not part of the Invisible Stalker entry, which is unchanged.

hp 80 (7d10+42)
Fort +13, Ref +11, Will +4
Defensive Abilities natural invisibility (see editor’s note below); Immune elemental traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +12 (2d6+4)

Variants

Advanced Invisible Stalker

Editor’s Note

Does invisibility purge work on creatures that are naturally invisible?

In general, yes–nothing in the spell description says it only works on spells or other magical sources of invisibility. However, note that the invisible stalker’s natural invisibility specifically says that it is not subject to invisibility purge. Thus, will-o’-wisps and pixies become visible, but invisible stalkers do not.
